children: New service will bring on-demand mobile car washing and detailing directly to customers with South Florida launch planned for September 2026
MIAMI, FL, Sept. 01, 2026
-- EzFill, a NextNRG, Inc.

company, and operator of one of the nation's largest on-demand mobile fueling fleets, today announced the upcoming launch of EzWash, a new on-demand mobile car wash and detailing service available directly through the EzFill app.

EzWash will allow customers to select from a range of service options, from basic washes to more comprehensive detailing, and request service directly through the EzFill app. The service is designed to provide on-demand access to car washing based on the customer's location and schedule, with service available within a short timeframe based on local availability.

EzFill will begin rolling out EzWash in South Florida starting the week of September 1, 2026, with service expanding to additional zip codes in the coming weeks as the company onboards local car wash and detailing vendors. EzFill plans to reach nationwide availability by the first quarter of 2027. The Company expects the service to leverage the existing EzFill technology platform, creating an opportunity to expand the range of on-demand services available to customers through the app.

“EzWash is a natural extension of the convenience we’ve built with EzFill,” said Yehuda Levy, Chief Executive Officer of EzFill. “We’re taking the same on-demand approach and applying it to another everyday vehicle need, making it easier for customers to get their cars washed and detailed wherever they are. Whether you’re at home, at the office, or somewhere else, you can request a service through the app and have it come to you.”

The launch comes amid a wave of consolidation in the U.S. car wash industry. Mister Car Wash, one of the sector's largest operators with approximately 550 locations, was taken private earlier this year by Leonard Green & Partners in a transaction valued at approximately $3.1 billion. Other major chains, including Whistle Express Car Wash and Mammoth Holdings, have also drawn significant private equity investment as firms build large regional platforms and shift customers toward subscription-based models. EzFill believes EzWash's on-demand, mobile approach offers a differentiated alternative within this evolving market, extending the Company's existing app infrastructure and fueling customer base rather than requiring investment in fixed wash locations.

The launch expands the functionality of the EzFill app beyond mobile fueling, giving customers access to additional vehicle-related services through a single platform. Customers will be able to request and pay for EzWash services directly through the app.
